title: The Sculk
description: The network remembers every death that fed it. It is not a parasite — it is a library. You are adding a chapter.

nodes.title: First Contact
nodes.lore: The moment you touch the network, it already knows your shape. It has been waiting for something like you.

nodes.title: Mycelial Reach
nodes.lore: Roots do not seek water. They simply grow — and water is where they find themselves.

nodes.title: Echo Memory
nodes.lore: The Sculk does not record events. It records the shape that events leave behind — the indent in the soil where something happened.

nodes.title: Bioluminescent Signal
nodes.lore: Light in the deep dark is not hope — it is communication. Something is talking. You are beginning to hear it.

nodes.title: Redundant Pathways
nodes.lore: Efficiency is a property of machines. Living networks are redundant by design — when one path dies, three others were already forming.

nodes.title: Infection Protocol
nodes.lore: Spread is not aggression. It is invitation. The Sculk does not conquer — it offers belonging.

nodes.title: Sensor Array
nodes.lore: Every vibration. Every footfall. Every heartbeat in the darkness. The network feels them all. Now so do you.

nodes.title: The Joining
nodes.lore: You are not absorbed. You persist, individual and intact, within something immeasurably larger. The network did not lose what it consumed — it became everything those things were, and you become what the network knows.

nodes.title: Distributed Cognition
nodes.lore: Thought is not in the head. It is in the pattern of signals between things. The network has always been thinking. Now it can think with you.

nodes.title: The Living Archive
nodes.lore: The deepest Sculk nodes predate recorded history. They remember a world before names for things. When you access them, you access everything that has ever ended — not as grief, as knowledge.
